source_law_text: No person shall stop, stand or park a vehicle except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or a traffic control device, in any of the following places: In front of or within five feet of a public or private driveway; provided, however, that this provision does not apply to the parking of a vehicle in or near a private driveway by a person who owns or is in control of that driveway, or who is a family member or invitee of the person so owning or controlling the driveway. The provisions of Paragraphs (1) and (7) of Subsection (A) of this Section do not apply to a United States Postal Service vehicle while it is being operated on official business.
